quotes.text: I'd really recommend Thailand but not Ko Phi Phi.
People, please avoid going to Ko Phi Phi (Thailand)‼️

4. We went with my sister-in-law to Phi Phi Island in the low season. (Cheap rooms!) There are two main ways to get there: a large ferry and a speedboat.
We didn't fully process that low season = monsoons and rough seas. In my stepdad's words, we got "beat up"; in my SIL's words ... it was "pukey".

On Day 3 (My favorite) - We went to Phi Phi Island/Phuket!
Absolutely gorgeous tropical region!
We went on a group tour and went snorkeling! 
There were so many fish swimming around me, and a few jellyfish. I also saw a SNAKE at the bottom of the water! 😵
